title: 소비자단체소송규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:13:0:00013:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 13 (Intervention as a Co-Litigant)
(1) An organization falling under any subparagraph of Article 70 of the Act may, with permission from the court under Article 74 (1), intervene as a co-litigant under Article 83 of the Civil Procedure Act in a consumer organization lawsuit pending between another organization and a business entity. In such cases, an application for intervention as a co-litigant and an application for permission for such intervention shall be deemed the complaint and the application for permission to institute a lawsuit under Article 73 (1) of the Act.
(2) In cases under paragraph (1), Article 73 (2) 2 and Article 74 (1) 3 of the Act shall not apply.
